extracted.intended_audience: SEC filers, registrants, transfer agents, securities lawyers, compliance officers, and EDGAR users
extracted.subtask_description: Table-of-contents style listing of Parts and Section headings from Title 17 of the Code of Federal Regulations (SEC rules), identifying regulatory requirements and procedural standards for electronic filings, forms, definitions, exemptions, and related filing practices required by the Commission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application of part 232
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifies the scope and applicability of Part 232 (Regulation S-T—General Rules and Regulations for Electronic Filings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of terms used in this part
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines terms used throughout Part 232 to interpret electronic filing rules and requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business hours of the Commission
rubrics_metrics.description: States the Commission's business hours relevant to filing and procedural timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date of filing; adjustment of filing date
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing the official filing date of submissions and any permitted adjustments to that date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paper filings not accepted without exemption
rubrics_metrics.description: General prohibition on paper filings except where an exemption is granted; establishes mandate for electronic filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administration of EDGAR
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules regarding the administration, operation, and use of EDGAR for electronic submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Persons and entities subject to mandated electronic filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Identifies which persons and entities are required to use EDGAR for mandated electronic filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandated electronic submissions and exceptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifies which submissions must be made electronically and enumerates any exceptions to mandatory electronic submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exhibits
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on the treatment, inclusion, and format of exhibits submitted electronically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Liability for transmission errors or omissions in documents filed via EDGAR
rubrics_metrics.description: Allocates liability for transmission errors or omitted content when filing documents through EDGAR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unofficial PDF copies included in an electronic submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on inclusion and treatment of unofficial PDF copies packaged with an electronic submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of HTML and hyperlinks
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and permitted uses for HTML formatting and hyperlinks in electronic submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition against electronic submissions containing executable code
rubrics_metrics.description: Prohibits submissions that include executable code to prevent malware or unauthorized code execution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Temporary hardship exemption
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedure for obtaining a temporary exemption from mandated electronic filing due to hardship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continuing hardship exemption
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedure for obtaining a continuing (longer-term) exemption from mandated electronic filing due to ongoing hardship.

rubrics_metrics.name: EDGAR Filer Manual
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to and requirements derived from the EDGAR Filer Manual governing the technical and procedural aspects of EDGAR submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signatures
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for signatures on electronic submissions, including acceptable forms and methods of signing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporation by reference
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for incorporating material by reference into filings and how such incorporations satisfy item answers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Graphic, image, audio and video material
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for submitting non-textual media within filings, including acceptable formats and limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of characters per line; tabular and columnar information
rubrics_metrics.description: Formatting standards for character counts per line and for presenting tabular or columnar data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreign language documents and symbols
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for submitting documents in foreign languages and use of special symbols in electronic filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bold face type
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance or requirements concerning the use of bold type in submissions (formatting emphasis rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Type size and font; legibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for font sizes, typefaces, and overall legibility of submitted materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paper size; binding; sequential numbering; number of copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for physical paper submissions (where accepted), including paper size, binding, numbering, and copy counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marking changed material
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for indicating amendments or changed material in filings to show modifications from prior versions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documents submitted in paper under cover of Form SE
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for submitting paper-format exhibits when an electronic filer uses Form SE as cover and the circumstances permitting that submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification of investment company type and series and/or class (or contract)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for clearly identifying the type of investment company and its series/class/contract in filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accommodation for certain securitizers of asset-backed securities
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific accommodations or tailored filing procedures for securitizers of asset-backed securities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interactive Data File submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures for interactive data (e.g., XBRL) file submissions as part of filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover Page XBRL Data Tagging
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for tagging cover page data using XBRL for machine-readable identification and indexing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interactive data financial report filings
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for filing financial reports with interactive data, including required exhibits and formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing fee exhibit interactive data
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for interactive data (XBRL) related to filing fee exhibits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modular submissions and segmented filings
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for submitting filings in modules or segments rather than a single document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on the availability and where to obtain prescribed SEC forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forms for Registration Statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Enumerates forms prescribed for registration statements under the Securities Act of 1933.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forms Pertaining to Exemptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Forms and procedural paperwork relating to exemption claims under the Securities Act.

rubrics_metrics.name: General Rules and Regulations, Securities Exchange Act of 1934
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level listing of general rules and regulations under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (Part 240).

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulation M — definitions and distribution activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules covering definitions and permissible activities by distribution participants, issuers, and selling security holders during a distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulation SHO — definition of short sale; marking requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines 'short sale' and specifies the marking and compliance requirements for short sales.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for alternative trading systems (ATS)
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions and operational, recordkeeping, and preservation requirements for ATSs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customer margin requirements for security futures
rubrics_metrics.description: Authority, purpose, scope, definitions and general provisions setting margin requirements for security futures customers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulation AC — Analyst Certification
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions and required certifications analysts must make in research reports and public appearances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulation NMS — national market system rules and obligations
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions, dissemination, display, order protection, minimum increments, consolidated audit trail, and other NMS requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulation SE — registration and regulation of SBSEFs
rubrics_metrics.description: Scope, applicable provisions, definitions, registration procedures, product filings, rule approvals, and core principles for security-based swap execution facilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulation SBSR — reporting and dissemination of security-based swap information
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions and obligations for reporting, public dissemination, error correction, and repository operation for security-based swaps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulation FD — selective disclosure rule
rubrics_metrics.description: General rule and definitions on selective disclosure of material nonpublic information and its effect on antifraud liability and reporting status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulation G — disclosure of non-GAAP financial measures
rubrics_metrics.description: General rules and definitions about the disclosure and presentation of non-GAAP financial measures and related liability considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulation Blackout Trading Restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions and prohibitions on insider trading during pension fund blackout periods, including exceptions and notice requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credit Risk Retention
rubrics_metrics.description: Authority, purpose, scope, definitions, retention requirements, transfer of retention, and exceptions/exemptions related to credit risk retention (e.g., risk retention by securitizers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulation R — exemptions for banks from 'broker' definition
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions and various exemptions and exceptions that allow banks to be excluded from the definition of 'broker' for certain activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulation S-P / S-AM / S-ID — privacy, affiliate marketing limits, identity theft red flags
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing privacy of consumer financial information (S-P), limitations on affiliate marketing (S-AM), and identity theft red flags (S-ID).

rubrics_metrics.name: Forms under the Exchange Act — availability and categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Listings and availability of forms required under the Exchange Act for registration, reports, applications, and other filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-Border antifraud law-enforcement authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules relating to cross-border anti-fraud law-enforcement authority and cooperation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proprietary Trading and Certain Interests in and Relationships with Covered Funds (Volcker/Section 619)
rubrics_metrics.description: Authority, definitions, proprietary trading restrictions, covered fund activities, compliance program requirements, and reporting/recordkeeping obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: General requirements of papers and applications (Investment Company Act)
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal and substantive requirements (form, content, amendments, incorporation by reference) applicable to papers and applications under the Investment Company Act.

rubrics_metrics.name: Valuation and treatment of portfolio securities (special cases)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for valuation of portfolio securities, ‘‘current net asset value,’’ fair value determinations and related recordkeeping for investment companies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exemptions for certain investment company structures and transactions
rubrics_metrics.description: Enumerates multiple specific exemptions applicable to particular investment company types, transactions, and organizational arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal requirements as to amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and signature requirements when filing amendments to applications, registration statements, or reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity and treatment of unknown or not reasonably available information
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards requiring clarity in submissions and instructions on how to handle information that is unknown or not reasonably available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statements required where item is inapplicable or where answer is 'none'
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to provide specified statements when an item does not apply or when the correct answer is 'none'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Words relating to periods of time in the past and future
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on tense and wording when referring to past or future periods in filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclaimer of control
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for disclaiming control where applicable in filings (e.g., ownership/control statements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Title of securities
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for how the title of securities must be presented in filings and documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporation rendering document incomplete, unclear, or confusing
rubrics_metrics.description: Prohibits incorporation by reference in a manner that makes the filing incomplete, unclear, or confusing; sets standards for proper identification of incorporated material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional exhibits; omission of substantially identical documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards permitting additional exhibits and rules for omitting substantially identical documents from exhibit lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspection of applications, statements and reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing public inspection and publication of filed documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: General requirements as to form and content of applications, statements and reports (Trust Indenture Act)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifies required form and content, number of copies, signatures, binding, and other formalities for submissions under the Trust Indenture Act.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application for EDGAR access (Form ID) and Form SE procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for applying for EDGAR access via Form ID and for using Form SE to submit paper exhibits where allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forms for reports and exemptions under Trust Indenture and Investment Company Acts
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists prescribed forms for eligibility, qualification, exemption requests, and various filings under the Trust Indenture and Investment Company Acts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Records to be maintained and preserved by registered entities
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements concerning which records must be created, maintained, and preserved by registered investment companies and others, including fair value determination records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sales literature and advertising — misleading content
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules deeming certain sales literature misleading and setting filing/retention standards for advertising materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidential treatment and filing of names/addresses of dealers
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for requesting confidential treatment and rules on filing sensitive dealer names and addresses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual and periodic reporting requirements for registered investment companies
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and specific forms/rules for annual reports, certifications (e.g., Form N-CSR), proxy voting records, monthly/quarterly reporting, and internet availability of reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exemptions and special provisions (many specific enumerated rules)
rubrics_metrics.description: Numerous enumerated section headings granting or defining exemptions, conditional exemptions, and special procedural treatments across the investment company and securities statutes.
